description: The 3 Rivers Wet Weather Sewer Atlas is a composite regional wastewater infrastructure dataset for the Pittsburgh area, assembled from contributing municipalities and authorities. The documentation page read on 2026-09-29 lists downloads as an open file geodatabase with a geometric network for tracing in ArcGIS, Esri Shapefiles and ArcGIS Desktop map packages, plus live map and feature service layers for ArcGIS Online users in a dedicated group; standard OGC web services are planned. 3 Rivers Wet Weather maintains it. Access is mainly for contributing municipalities through the Municipal Data Support site, and other parties may request access, so it is treated as on request. Coverage is one metropolitan region at pipe level. The page gives no licence, layer list, counts or dates, and a documentation portal and change log are available. Caveats: the data are contributed by many owners, so completeness varies by municipality. It suits network flow and capacity studies of combined and separate sewers and wet weather overflow control. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
